title: Application to exempt Bronx housing rehab from property taxes
summary: The Council would approve a seven-year real property tax exemption for a housing project at four sites in the Bronx owned by Neighborhood Renewal Housing Development Fund Corporation. The exemption, requested by the Department of Housing Preservation and Development, applies under Section 577 of the Private Housing Finance Law and covers Block 2265 Lots 2 and 3, Block 2282 Lot 12, Block 2620 Lot 34 and Block 3107 Lot 29. It can end early if the owner violates program rules or transfers the property without HPD approval.
